comment: The “components that deliver it” column lists registries and the Terminology Service as common references but does not identify the exchange services, gateways, endpoints, event brokers, APIs, trust services, or mediation functions through which technical interoperability is realised.

public.text: The “components that deliver it” column lists registries and the Terminology Service as common references but does not identify the exchange services, gateways, endpoints, event brokers, APIs, trust services, or mediation functions through which technical interoperability is realised.
public.suggestedRevision: Rename the column to “Components and cross-cutting capabilities that support it,” and include standards-based endpoints, defined exchange patterns, trust services, audit, and mediation where required.
